data.one_liner: Official Mapbox Maps SDK for Flutter to render interactive vector maps.
data.what_it_does: Adds a native, GPU-accelerated MapWidget to render Mapbox Vector Tiles, GeoJSON, and custom styles across Android, iOS, and Web. Provides camera controls, markers, location puck tracking, and offline map caching.
use_when: You need to display custom, vector-based interactive maps powered by Mapbox.
Your app targets Android, iOS, and Web with native map rendering.
You require advanced mapping features like custom styles, vector layers, and location tracking.
avoid_when: You prefer an open-source mapping solution without third-party proprietary dependencies.
You only need basic raster maps without Mapbox infrastructure.
strengths: Official SDK supporting Android, iOS, and Web with hardware acceleration.
Rich set of customization features including custom styles, annotations, and camera controls.
Supports offline map caching on mobile platforms.
weaknesses: Requires a Mapbox access token and active account.
CocoaPods distribution is no longer supported on iOS (requires Swift Package Manager).
data.setup_notes: Configure a Mapbox access token via --dart-define. Add location permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist if using the location puck. Swift Package Manager is required for iOS.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: A pure Flutter map widget using OpenStreetMap tiles without requiring third-party API tokens.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer Google Maps over Mapbox for your application.
